recordText: From the 1510s, meaning elegantly, daintily; from about 1600, extremely cautiously. Origin unknown. The OED suggests, as a perhaps, Old French *gensor*, "more dainty," which traces back to the same Latin as *gentle*.
gossipText: Arrived elegant and became careful. Nobody knows what happened in between, least of all Gingerly.
testimony: Origin unknown. I know. Please stop looking at me. I was elegant once. Then I got careful. That's not a crime. Is it?
cameoLines: Someone tiptoes past. Very elegantly. Very carefully.
Gingerly picks up a fork as if it might go off.
